description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 13.06.2016 to 19.06.2016
reasoning: This gazette notification announces new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, specifically determining how customs duties and other charges will be calculated based on currency exchange rates. The content involves legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
